sn51.1:1.1: _Iddhi_ (Sanskrit _ṛddhi_) conveys the root sense “increase, success”. In the Atharva Veda we find _samṛddhi_ and _vyṛddhi_  in the sense “prosperity” and “misfortune” (eg. 10.2.10). As “success, completion” (of the sacrifice) we find _ṛddhi_ at Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 4.6.9.11. As far as I know, the Buddhist texts are where we first find _iddhi_ in the sense of “psychic power”, and it is not attested in that sense until later (Bhāgavata Purāṇa 3.20.53, 9.21.12).
